page.title: Design workspace settings
page.purpose: Inspect presentation preferences and qualified source, storage and runtime limitations.

priorities.statement: Separate preferences from authority; settings cannot grant effects.
Explain qualified limits, source freshness and retention policy.
Keep keyboard access and readable compact layouts.

states.description: Show the current selection and available next actions.
Identify pending work without implying an empty result.
Show the submitted operation and prevent accidental duplicate effects.
Keep unsaved and persisted revision identity distinct.
Identify the source being synchronized and keep usable context.
Retain usable previous content with freshness labels.
Explain a confirmed empty result and a relevant next step.
Show usable content and the omitted or failed portion.
Show source age and the consequences of stale evidence.
Show the completed operation and its exact result identity.
Identify actionable findings while preserving draft content.
Explain failed work without discarding context.
Identify the unmet authority boundary without suggesting bypass.
Retain available context and identify unavailable operations.
Retry safely with operation identity and visible progress.
